articulation.label: living room
articulation.alt: living room: /l/ → /ɪ/ → /v/ → /ɪ/ → /ŋ/ → /r/ → /u/ → /m/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /l/: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
/v/: Upper teeth touch the lower lip; add voice.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
/ŋ/: Back of tongue at soft palate; air through nose.
/r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/u/: High back tongue; round the lips.
/m/: Close both lips; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
